description: AI-synthesized scenario brief for an investing decision — NOT a prediction market. Compares a supplied position or portfolio (commodity, currency pair, sovereign, sector, and/or entity exposure) across current / 30d / 60d / 90d / tail-risk regime scenarios, using DPX's live transition-risk, causal-graph, and commodity/currency/sovereign/supply-chain/ESG signals. Returns dominant drivers, the closest historical analogue, per-position signals, and a synthesized comparative narrative for decision support. Requires a pre-purchased DPX Reports API key via Authorization: Bearer <key>, or pass apiKey.

positions.description: Up to 20 positions. Each item: { type: "commodity"|"currency_pair"|"sovereign"|"sector"|"entity", symbol?, from?, to?, country?, name?, geography?, address?, weight? }.

scenario.description: Optional named commodity stress scenario (e.g. la_nina_moderate, gulf_hurricane_major) applied on top of any commodity positions.

name: reports.scenario
